integrity: Symbolic proof establishes all positive integer parameters. Exact finite checks are supplemental. Earlier source results on singular rank, tangent cones, and motivic classes are credited; no independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to closed complex points of banana graph hypersurfaces with n≥4; exact Zariski-local contact/product equivalence, not a globally glued trivialization or a theorem on arbitrary graph hypersurfaces. Multiplicity, tangent-cone and boundary-incidence information were previously known; the claimed advance is the explicit all-order coordinate isomorphism. An unindexed equivalent earlier local-trivialization result remains possible.
title: Algebraically conical germs along every singular stratum of banana graph hypersurfaces
